d:
A special POCSO court in Bhopal has sentenced 78-year-old Pyare Miyan to 10 life terms in a case involving the sexual abuse of minor girls. Who is Pyare Miyan? How did the case come to light, how was he arrested in Srinagar, and what does receiving 10 life sentences legally mean?
Production: Akash Singh
Video Editor: Rahul Kumar
